# SBFB / nexus-grid

> Decentralized P2P compute network for apps. No central server, no admin, just
> protocol. Anyone publishes a web app from verifiable source; the network
> distributes it; clients render it in a sandboxed iframe via the Rust blob-serve
> daemon. AGPL-3.0.
>
> **Scope of this index — sharding subsystem only.** This `llms.txt` currently
> indexes the **distributed-inference (sharding)** subsystem, which has a
> dedicated agent-consumable docs layer. A whole-repo agent index is **deferred**
> (its own future phase/sprint). For everything else, read `CLAUDE.md` (project
> overview) and `docs/claude/README.md` (workflow).

## Sharding (distributed LLM inference)

- [Sharding agent index](docs/sharding/llms.txt): the entry point — Truth Stack, PROVISIONAL status, links to the wiring spec, wire primitives, runnable examples, and human docs.
- [Wiring spec for agents](docs/sharding/WIRING_SPEC.md): contract-dense, source-anchored — read before wiring or reviewing the pipeline.
- [Wire spec](docs/protocol/SHARD_PROTOCOL_SPEC.md): machine wire spec — domain tags, generated JSON Schemas, types, caps.

*Everything outside sharding is intentionally not agent-indexed yet (whole-repo
index deferred); for project orientation read the human files named in the scope
banner above (`CLAUDE.md`, `docs/claude/README.md`).*
